snippet.title: Fleet Hunters - Official Release Trailer | 1st of September | Steam
snippet.description:
Fleet Hunters launches on Steam.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4074510/Fleet_Hunters/

Fleet Hunters is a playful, modern take on classic grid-based naval battles. Find and destroy your opponent’s hidden ships before they sink yours in fast real-time duels where every hit, miss, and weapon cooldown matters.

Play against AI opponents, challenge your Steam friends, join online matchmaking, create private matches, or battle over LAN. Prefer the traditional experience? Switch to turn-based Classic Mode.

FEATURES

• Fast naval battles with simultaneous attacks
• Online matchmaking and private matches
• Steam friend invitations
• Single-player battles against AI
• Local network multiplayer over LAN
• Traditional turn-based Classic Mode

Developed and published by GNARLY LABS (solo indie game dev).

Wishlist Fleet Hunters and prepare for battle.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4074510/Fleet_Hunters/
